parameters.name: images
parameters.description: 1 to 8 photos of the object to build. Leave empty when editing a 3D model.
parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value — a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: sceneFile
parameters.description: Optional. Add any 3D model to edit it instead of building a new one. It comes back in the same format.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Building: name the object, like "a tugboat". Editing: describe the change, like "open the lid".

parameters.name: buildEffort
parameters.description: Standard for simple objects or small edits like a recolor. High or Maximum for detailed objects, or edits that add or reshape parts. When editing, match it to the change, not the model.

parameters.name: faceBudget
parameters.description: Max triangles for a new model: 10k–50k for games, 250k for fine detail. Not used when editing.
